recognize_zh: 箭頭處的異常前骨髓球胞質中有一束束交錯的粉紫色棒狀 Auer rods（柴束細胞，faggot cell），周圍還有顆粒極多、核呈雙葉或腎形的前骨髓球，是急性前骨髓球白血病（APL）的必考影像。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte with bundles of multiple crisscrossing Auer rods in the cytoplasm (faggot cell)
Folded, reniform to bilobed nucleus with fine chromatin
Neighboring abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nuclear outline
Several cells with bilobed (butterfly-like) or folded nuclei
Background of red cells; no significant maturing granulocytes in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules and folded to bilobed nuclei. One cell contains bundles of multiple Auer rods arranged in a crisscross pattern, characteristic of a faggot cell. Normal granulocytic maturation is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation work-up for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: This AML shows blasts with single slender Auer rods, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules with maturation, rather than hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes with bundled Auer rods.
Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with Golgi zones, lack Auer rods, and are followed by orderly maturation.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed nuclei with sparse fine granules and rare faggot cells, although it carries the same PML::RARA fusion.
